scene.velvet.msg.bed_unreachable: I can't get to the bed.
gui.velvet.scene_step_behind: Step right behind %s, where she climbed onto the bed
skill.velvet.endurance.desc: Grows when she takes damage, runs and finishes scenes. +2 max health per level, longer scenes, longer runs and longer without food.
skill.velvet.affection.desc: Grows from finished scenes and time near her owner.
skill.velvet.capacity.desc: Grows from finished scenes. Her inventory: 1 slot at level 0, more with every level, 27 at level 10.
skill.velvet.kindness.desc: How gentle and caring she is.
skill.velvet.building.desc: Skill at building and placing blocks.
skill.velvet.weapons.desc: Grows with every hit she lands on a monster.
skill.velvet.tools.desc: Skill with pickaxes, shovels and hoes.
skill.velvet.agility.desc: Grows as she walks. +3% speed per level.
editor.velvet.title: Editor: %s
editor.velvet.name: Name
editor.velvet.view_hint: Click: pick · drag: turn · right: move · wheel: zoom
editor.velvet.no_npcs: You don't have any NPCs yet. Spawn one with her egg or open the menu of one without an owner.
editor.velvet.pick_npc: Pick one of your NPCs on the left. Only NPCs in loaded chunks can be edited.
editor.velvet.not_loaded: Too far away: her chunk isn't loaded
editor.velvet.leave_unsaved: Unsaved changes! Click her tab again to drop them
editor.velvet.persona.hint: Who is she? How does she talk, what does she like?
editor.velvet.chat_hint: Talk to her in chat: start the message with "%1$s," or write @%1$s.
editor.velvet.skin.no_files: Put PNG files into .minecraft/velvet/skins, or export hers to paint over.
editor.velvet.skin.uploaded: On the server: save to keep it
editor.velvet.ai.wander.tooltip: She walks around by herself when she has nothing to do.
editor.velvet.ai.pick_up_items.tooltip: Goes for items lying around. With a full inventory she only swaps her cheapest things for better ones.
editor.velvet.ai.auto_eat.tooltip: Eats from her inventory when hungry.
editor.velvet.ai.flee_monsters.tooltip: Runs from monsters along the safest route.
editor.velvet.ai.survival.tooltip: Everything below. Off: she only runs away.
editor.velvet.ai.fight_back.tooltip: Fights monsters she can beat. Never creepers or bosses.
editor.velvet.ai.stealth.tooltip: In the deep dark, near sculk and around a warden she sneaks: no vibrations, smaller, slower.
editor.velvet.ai.dig_in.tooltip: Weak or cornered, she digs into soft ground and covers herself. Afterwards the ground is put back.
editor.velvet.ai.pillar_up.tooltip: Cornered by monsters that can't climb or shoot: three blocks up.
editor.velvet.ai.use_items.tooltip: Best gear from her inventory, totem, golden apples, potions, ender pearls.
editor.velvet.ai.ask_for_help.tooltip: Writes in chat when she has nothing to defend herself with, or nothing to eat.
editor.velvet.ai.chat.tooltip: Who sees what she writes: only her owner (private), or the whole server (public).
editor.velvet.ai.models: Models (%s): click one, or type any id
editor.velvet.ai.local_not_allowed: Local and custom addresses: only for operators on this server
editor.velvet.ai.setup.anthropic: Make a key at console.anthropic.com (API keys), paste it here and save. Requests go through the server with your key; you pay Anthropic for them.
editor.velvet.ai.setup.openai: Make a key at platform.openai.com (API keys) and add credit to the account. Paste the key here and save.
editor.velvet.ai.setup.gemini: Get a free key in Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com, Get API key), paste it here and save.
editor.velvet.ai.setup.deepseek: Make a key at platform.deepseek.com (API keys), top up the balance, paste the key here and save.
editor.velvet.ai.setup.qwen: Make an API key in Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (international), paste it here and save.
editor.velvet.ai.setup.xai: Make a key at console.x.ai, paste it here and save.
editor.velvet.ai.setup.mistral: Make a key at console.mistral.ai (API keys), paste it here and save.
editor.velvet.ai.setup.openrouter: One key for hundreds of models: openrouter.ai/keys. Paste it here, then load the list and pick any model.
editor.velvet.ai.setup.ollama: Install Ollama on the computer the server runs on, then e.g. "ollama pull llama3.1". No key needed; the address is that computer's.
editor.velvet.ai.setup.lmstudio: Start LM Studio's local server (Developer tab) on the server's computer, load a model, then load the list here. No key needed.
editor.velvet.ai.setup.custom: Any OpenAI-compatible API (vLLM, llama.cpp, text-generation-webui, a proxy...): its address up to /v1, and a key if it wants one.
chat.velvet.ai.no_key: %s should talk through %s, but you have no key for it saved (NPC editor, AI tab)
chat.velvet.ai.no_endpoint: %s has no address for her language model (NPC editor, AI tab)
chat.velvet.help.weapon: Help! A %s is after me at %s and I have nothing to fight with!
chat.velvet.help.hurt: Help, I'm badly hurt! A %s is attacking me at %s!
chat.velvet.help.generic: A %s is attacking me at %s! Please come!
chat.velvet.help.hungry: I'm starving... could you bring me something to eat?
chat.velvet.help.hidden: I dug myself in at %s. I'll wait here until it's safe.
chat.velvet.internal.no_home: I don't have a home yet.
chat.velvet.internal.idle.3: If you want to really talk, give me a language model in the editor.
editor.velvet.preset.hint: Pick the model she wears: each one has its own animations, voice and scenes.
editor.velvet.new_npc.free: A blank NPC appears next to you (free in creative).
editor.velvet.new_npc.costs: A blank NPC appears next to you. Costs one spawn egg.
editor.velvet.new_npc.needs_egg: You need a spawn egg for that
editor.velvet.debug.creative_only: The debug tool works in creative only
editor.velvet.ai.internal.about: Her own brain, nothing to set up. She looks after herself whatever brain she has: fights what she can beat, runs from the rest, hides, eats, puts on her gear and mines when it's quiet. In chat she understands short orders: follow, stay, home, fight, run, hide, mine, gather blocks, eat, gear up. A language model talks for real and can give her the same orders when you ask.
editor.velvet.persona.help: Goes to the language model with every message. The internal brain doesn't use it.
editor.velvet.debug.survival.tooltip: All of the below. Off: she only runs.
editor.velvet.debug.fight_back.tooltip: Fights when she would win: her weapon, armor, shield and healing against them.
editor.velvet.debug.use_shield.tooltip: Raises it against arrows and blows, lowers it to strike.
editor.velvet.debug.stealth.tooltip: When she sees a warden, sculk right by her or the darkness of a shrieker.
editor.velvet.debug.shelter.tooltip: Cornered with blocks: walls and a roof around her.
editor.velvet.debug.pillar_up.tooltip: Out of reach of monsters that only hit up close.
editor.velvet.debug.dig_in.tooltip: Into soft ground, covering the hole; the ground is put back afterwards.
editor.velvet.debug.gather_blocks.toolti: Mines natural ground to build with when she has few blocks.
editor.velvet.debug.mine_ores.tooltip: Ores she sees, with a fitting tool, while it's quiet.
editor.velvet.debug.use_items.tooltip: Armor, weapons, food, golden apples, potions, totems, pearls, torches.
editor.velvet.debug.ask_for_help.tooltip: In chat, when she has nothing left to defend herself with or to eat.
editor.velvet.debug.ai.tooltip: Off: she stands still like a mob without AI.
Off: hits from players do nothing.
editor.velvet.debug.character.soon: Her character (temper, likes, fears) will be set here. Coming later.
gui.velvet.no_scenes: %s has no scenes. Pick another preset in the editor.
